summary: Front matter: cover (p1), title page (p2), CIP/colophon (p3), a recommendation preface by 萧明道 (p4-5), the author's own preface 自序 (p6-7) and the start of the 前言 (p8). It lays out Cai Sen's core philosophy: volume-price structure (量价结构) is the most leading of all indicators, patterns formed by volume-price reveal the main force's (主力) intent, and the trading method is swing trading with the trend, strict stops (5%-7% for longs), and taking profit at the computed measured-move target (涨跌幅满足) to achieve 'big wins, small losses' (大赚小赔). Short-term trading is rejected; trend is judged on daily/weekly charts of at least half a year, with 5-minute/hourly charts used only to time entry when a longer-term pattern is about to turn.

rules.rule: Volume-price relationship is the most leading indicator; all other indicators (KD, RSI, MACD, DMI) derive from the K-line chart and lag. Volume is the cause, price the effect.
rules.quote_zh: 发现唯有量价关系才是所有指标的最先行指标。

rules.rule: Price direction is decided by volume (real money); learning lagging indicators is a waste of time.
rules.quote_zh: 毕竟现实上钱（量）才能真正决定商品的价格（价），因此价格的方向是由量来决定的。

rules.rule: Main-force phases (bottom accumulation, attack/markup, top distribution, distribution by holding price down at high levels) can mostly be judged from the patterns produced by volume-price structure.
rules.quote_zh: 因此无论底部承接布局、攻击拉抬、盘头出货、高档压低出货等，大多可以从量价结构产生的型态来做判断

rules.rule: The bullish trigger after the main force completes bottom accumulation is an attack volume (攻击量) that breaks out of the bottom consolidation zone; only after that do short/medium/long-term indicators turn bullish one after another.
rules.quote_zh: 例如主力进货盘底完成后，出现突破底部整理区的攻击量后，所有短中长期指标才会陆续出现翻多信号。

rules.rule: Core operating mode: trade with the trend and set stops; longs watch support, shorts watch resistance; strictly execute the stop to exit with a small loss; conversely, when the preset measured-move target (涨跌幅满足) is reached, take the swing profit.
rules.quote_zh: 随势操作善设停损，多头看支撑，空头看压力，严格执行停损才能小赔出场。反之，达设定的涨跌幅满足，则波段获利了结，以达大赚小赔的目的。

rules.rule: Long stop is set within about 5%-7% when a bottom has completed and issued a buy signal; the bottom pattern's support protects the long. Shorts on a completed top are the mirror image.
rules.quote_zh: 如一档股票底部完成出现买进信号时，多单进场停损设约在5%～7%以内，有底部的型态支撑保护多头

rules.rule: Author's stated experience: stop-outs (breaking support) occur roughly 20%-30% of the time, wins roughly 70%-80%, and a swing typically yields at least ~20% (main force usually moves price at least 20% per wave). Small-probability small losses vs larger-probability big gains -> long-run 大赚小赔.
rules.quote_zh: 经验上跌破支撑停损的机率约在两至三成，相对的获利机率约有七至八成，而一个波段至少约20%或以上的获利机率（通常主力作价一波至少20%），反之，头部完成时的做空亦然

rules.rule: Do not be impatient; opportunities must be waited for. One or two big long/short timing opportunities per year in the Taiwan index are enough. Wait and watch until the opportunity comes; be bold but careful when it does.
rules.quote_zh: 操作不要急躁，行情是等来的，当机会来时胆大心细

rules.rule: Take profit when the estimated swing target is reached; do not get greedy (most people fail through greed and give back gains).
rules.quote_zh: 记得达预估的波段满足就好，莫再贪心才能持盈保泰，多数人都败在贪心，以致于前功尽弃。

rules.rule: Avoid short-term trading: short-term profits are luck; long-run short-term trading fails; decades-long success comes from swing trading.
rules.quote_zh: 我在任何场合都会强调“切忌短线操作”，短线操作能获利只是一时的运气，长期操作短线必败……要记得那句常见的标语“滚石不生苔，短线不聚财”。

rules.rule: Success rate improves with experience; study historical volume-price structures and how patterns developed afterwards (history is the best teacher) before trading.
rules.quote_zh: 历史是学习最好的教材……多研究以往的量价结构产生的型态后的发展有绝对的帮助

rules.rule: The author's long-held method: strict stops, money management, swing trading with the trend. Swings last from a few months up to several years and are based on the long-term chart.
rules.quote_zh: 长久以来，我坚守的操作方法是“严设停损，资金控管，波段随势操作”。波段操作是以长线为基础，时间短至数月，长至数年

rules.rule: Short-term horizon traps you in main-force set-ups ('earn small, lose big'); a longer view lets you see the main force and the trend, and with proper stops your errors stay small.
rules.quote_zh: 短线的格局太短，会陷入主力设局的陷阱框框中，无法了解真正的趋势，当然容易任人宰割赚小钱赔大钱。

rules.rule: Judge the trend on daily or weekly charts covering at least half a year; only when the pattern structure is about to reach a turning point use 5-minute or hourly charts (themselves viewed over 2-3 months) to time an early entry.
rules.quote_zh: 既然是波段操作，当然就是尽量使用半年以上的日线或周线来做趋势上的判断，当型态上的结构有机会到达转折时，小时线或五分钟线便是掌握先机的重要参考指标

rules.rule: Lower-timeframe entry trigger: when price reaches the upper neckline with shrinking volume consolidating just before the barrier (量缩关前整理) and timing is judged ripe, enter actively as soon as the 5-minute or hourly chart breaks the neckline WITH volume (带量突破颈线), setting a stop at the same time.
rules.quote_zh: 当来到上缘颈线量缩关前整理判断时机已成熟时，一旦五分钟线或小时线带量突破颈线，便作积极介入同时设好停损即可，主要看的还是波段的大利润。

worked_examples.pattern: completed bottom -> long; completed top -> short
worked_examples.outcome: n.a. (illustrative expectancy argument for 大赚小赔)
n.a. - author says catching one or two such opportunities is enough to compound capital

worked_examples.timeframe: 5-minute / hourly viewed over 2-3 months, within daily/weekly trend
worked_examples.pattern: approx. 3-month bottom on K-line, volume-backed neckline break on lower timeframe

quantifiable: Initial long stop distance: entry_price * (1 - 0.05..0.07), placed under the bottom pattern's support (p7).
Trend timeframe filter: only evaluate patterns on daily or weekly bars with a lookback >= ~6 months (p8).

Lower-timeframe trigger: on 5m/1h bars with ~2-3 months of history, require volume contraction while price consolidates just below the neckline, then a breakout bar closing above the neckline with expanded volume (p8).
Bottom breakout confirmation: breakout out of the bottom consolidation range must be accompanied by attack volume (volume expansion vs prior consolidation average) (p6).
Exit at the pattern's measured-move target (涨跌幅满足) rather than trailing indefinitely (p6-7).
Expected swing size prior: >= 20% per main-force wave; a target < ~20% may be considered low-value (inference from p7).
ambiguities: '攻击量' and '带量' are not quantified here (no multiple of average volume given).
Stop is given both as a percent band (5%-7%, p7) and as 'below support' (跌破支撑); unclear which governs when they differ.
Win rate 70%-80% and >=20% wave gain are the author's experience claims, not backtested statistics.
'量缩关前整理' (low-volume consolidation before the barrier) has no defined duration or volume threshold.
Recommendation preface (p4-5) is by a third party (萧明道) and contains endorsements, not rules; its 量是因，价为果 statement is consistent with the author's 自序.

front_matter.cover_quote_zh: 散户为何会赔钱？因为多空转折出现了却不会判断，进场比人晚，退场更晚，获利顶多小赚，亏损却是大赔！
front_matter.cover_subtitle_zh: 蔡森12招投资稳定获利的「赢家秘技」；29年实战经验；12招判断多空转折的方法，让你聪明掌握进出场点时机！
